# EventShark

> EventShark is a B2B video production agency for AI, SaaS, and logistics companies. Full-time teams in Austin, New York, and San Francisco, with vetted shooters nationwide. Services: event and conference coverage, customer stories and testimonials, and content, clips and social. Tagline: B2B video, anywhere you need.

## Pages
- [Services](https://eventshark.io/services): Event coverage, customer stories, content and social clips
- [Portfolio](https://eventshark.io/portfolio): Selected work by category with client names
- [About](https://eventshark.io/about): Team, values, and positioning
- [Contact](https://eventshark.io/contact): Book a call or send project details; market coverage FAQ

## Facts
- Markets: Austin, New York, San Francisco (full-time teams); nationwide coverage
- Industries: AI, SaaS, logistics and 3PL, enterprise B2B
- Engagement: single projects and retainers
- Contact: ding@eventshark.io
